Name: Pokecrows
Author: xaandiir
Description:
[center][b]WHAT DOES THIS MOD DO[/b]

This mod changes the scarecrows + rarecrows in the game into pokemon scarecrows resembling some legendary pokemon.
[b]
HOW TO INSTALL[/b]

- Install the latest version of SMAPI and Content Patcher
- Download and unzip file
- Drop file into your "\Stardew Valley\Mods" folder
- Run game with SMAPI

[u]Feel free to ask if you have any questions![/u]

Note: At the moment I'm taking mod requests. Especially pokemon related! Send me a message on here or on my tumblr (@xaandiir or @meadows-farm) and I'll try to get to them :)

I hope to make more Pokemon mods in the future.[/center][center]

[b][size=3][u]Now compatible with other mods that change the Craftables XNB![/u][/size][/b][/center]
